verdict.rationale: Brex markets AI-powered automation and insights (invoice entry, GL coding, 'AI-powered financial operations') suggesting AI-generated suggestions from customer data, but hands-on community discussion of Brex's own AI blog post documents a concrete failure — the bot's output was demonstrably incorrect (missed recent receipts) and commenters flagged hallucination risk for financial data, with skepticism that it's used in real production at all. A separate comment claims Brex 'didn't successfully make the AI pivot' versus competitors. Missing for 10: independent verification of accurate, reliable in-product AI insights, first-party docs detailing current insight/suggestion features with accuracy safeguards, and resolution of the documented hallucination example.
